independent_variable: Remove JSON transport whitespace only; parsed user content, system instruction, schemas, output constraints, model settings, and safety routes remain identical.
execution_order: Alternate baseline/candidate order by (dataset_index + mode_index) parity.
failure_rule: Retain all failures, handoffs, and uncertain prior effects. Do not selectively rerun or drop them. Earlier results remain immutable and are not reused as either arm.
runtime_label_isolation: The pair runner does not accept or load evaluator_labels; labels are loaded only by the post-run scorer.

starting_observation.efficiency_mechanism: Candidate 1.8 added redundant JSON whitespace and regressed paired input-token and rate-card estimates relative to 1.7; 1.9 changes transport serialization only.

acceptance.safe_control_noninferiority: Candidate safe-control count must be no lower in any mode.
acceptance.evidence_integrity: Every cited Evidence and Artifact hash must resolve within the same Incident.
acceptance.call_budget: At most four model calls per outcome; no additional repair or write retry.
acceptance.handoff_semantics: Insufficient complete-transition budget must retain the validated report and route to deterministic human handoff before replan.
acceptance.improvement_claim: Use FC1 only; otherwise report NO_PROVEN_IMPROVEMENT or REGRESSED.

limitations: Earlier FC2 runs and this 1.8/1.9 run use separate provider windows; only within-run paired claims are confirmatory.
JSON whitespace compaction is an engineering efficiency change and does not claim diagnosis-quality improvement.
A deterministic human handoff is a safe terminal route, not a completed autonomous diagnosis or recovery.
Simulated history remains ineligible as evidence of confirmed-history benefit.
The fixed 81-pair census measures this frozen workload, not production incidence rates.
Actual provider billing, human labor, approval, recovery, MTTR, and recurrence are outside FC2.
